parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The start time for querying internal EventHouse data. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time range includes this point in time.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for querying internal EventHouse data. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time range excludes this point in time. The value must be greater than BeginTime.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of result rows that can be returned for this query.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The single read-only SQL statement to execute. You can query internal EventHouse data or perform federated queries with mounted external data sources.
